GeneratorRef.description: Which generator was asked, and at exactly which revision.

adapter.description: Adapter name within this project, e.g. 'ace-step'. Not a package name.
adapter.title: Adapter

model_id.description: Upstream model identity, e.g. a Hugging Face repository id.
model_id.title: Model Id

revision.description: Exact upstream revision: a commit sha, never a moving branch or tag. Null means the revision is not pinned yet, and a null revision must block generation rather than resolve to whatever is current today.
revision.title: Revision

GeneratorRef.title: GeneratorRef

description: A request for a specimen. Nothing here is an observation about audio.

generator_params.description: Generator-specific parameters, contained here rather than in the envelope.
generator_params.title: Generator Params

requested_duration_s.description: Requested duration in seconds. The rendered audio may differ.
requested_duration_s.title: Requested Duration S

requested_instruments.description: Instruments the prompt asks for. Their presence in the result is an open question that only analysis of the audio can answer.
requested_instruments.title: Requested Instruments

requested_key.description: Requested key or scale as free text, e.g. 'D minor'. Deliberately unmodelled: there is no key ontology in this project yet, and inventing one here would outrun the evidence.
requested_key.title: Requested Key

requested_prompt.description: Natural-language request. A request, not a description of the result.
requested_prompt.title: Requested Prompt

seed.description: Generator seed. Part of reproducibility, not of musical truth.
seed.title: Seed

specimen_id.description: Stable identifier for this specimen, independent of any rendering of it.
specimen_id.title: Specimen Id

title: SongSpec
